vacancy.title: Assembly & Integration Technician (AI-Technician)
vacancy.location: Oegstgeest / Leiden area, Netherlands (Airbus Defence and Space Netherlands; not ESTEC)
vacancy.assessment: Hands-on mechanical assembly and integration of Airbus Netherlands space hardware (solar arrays, launcher structures) in Leiden/Oegstgeest. Requires MBO mechanical/mechatronics background and practical assembly, precision fitting, documentation and quality control; MSc candidates allowed only with clear commitment to remaining in technician role. Under-level relative to user's MSc and mechanical design leadership; no direct ESTEC placement. One-year deta-vast assignment with possible permanent conversion, salary not specified. Official hiring desk closing date 30 Nov 2026.
